```{r}
# Detect subsurface chlorophyll accumulations that surface measurements miss
detect_subsurface_accumulation <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(castpk, date, station) %>%
    filter(pres >= 1, pres <= 50, !is.na(f_npq)) %>%
    arrange(pres) %>%
    filter(n() >= 6, max(pres) >= 8) %>%  # cast has at least 7 depths and max >8m
    summarise(
      # Surface reference (what a buoy/satellite would see)
      surface_chl = mean(f_npq[pres <= 2], na.rm = TRUE),  # give the mean of only <2m
      near_surface_chl = mean(f_npq[pres <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),  # Buoy depth
      
      # Subsurface characteristics
      subsurface_max = max(f_npq[pres > 2], na.rm = TRUE),  # Below surface measurement
      subsurface_max_depth = pres[pres > 2][which.max(f_npq[pres > 2])], #finds max flu below 2m depth
      
      # Integrated characteristics (key for biomass assessment)
      integrated_chl = sum(f_npq[pres <= 50] * c(diff(pres[pres <= 50])[1],
                                                 diff(pres[pres <= 50])),
                           na.rm = TRUE),  # Rough integration
      surface_integrated = sum(f_npq[pres <= 5] * diff(pres)[1], na.rm = TRUE),  # Surface layer only
      subsurface_integrated = integrated_chl - surface_integrated,  # Below surface layer
      
      # Profile characteristics
      max_chl_overall = max(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), #profile max chl
      max_depth_overall = pres[which.max(f_npq)], #profile max depth
      profile_mean = mean(f_npq[pres <= 50], na.rm = TRUE), #profile mean chl
      
      # Biomass distribution metrics
      subsurface_integrated_fraction = subsurface_integrated / integrated_chl,  # Fraction below 5m
      surface_fraction = surface_integrated / integrated_chl,
      surface_representation = surface_chl / profile_mean,  # How well surface represents profile
      
      month = month(first(date)),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      # Calculate enhancement ratios
      subsurface_max_surface_ratio = subsurface_max / surface_chl,
      subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio = subsurface_max / near_surface_chl,
      
      # Key criteria for subsurface accumulation
      has_subsurface_accumulation = case_when(
        # High biomass cases where surface misses significant chlorophyll
        subsurface_max > 5.0 &  # Substantial chlorophyll maximum
        (subsurface_max_surface_ratio > 1.5 | subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio > 1.5) &  # Surface underestimates
        subsurface_integrated_fraction > 0.4 &  # Significant subsurface biomass
        subsurface_max_depth > 5 ~ TRUE,  # Clearly subsurface
        
        # Moderate biomass but strong subsurface signal
        subsurface_max > 2.0 &
        subsurface_max_surface_ratio > 2.0 &
        subsurface_integrated_fraction > 0.5 &
        surface_representation < 0.7 ~ TRUE,  # Surface poorly represents profile
        
        # Lower biomass but very strong subsurface concentration
        subsurface_max_surface_ratio > 3.0 &
        subsurface_integrated_fraction > 0.6 &
        subsurface_max_depth > 3 ~ TRUE,
        
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      
  # Classify type of subsurface accumulation
      accumulation_type = case_when(
        !has_subsurface_accumulation & integrated_chl > 100 ~ "surface_bloom",
        !has_subsurface_accumulation ~ "no bloom",
        subsurface_max > 10 ~ "high_biomass_scm",
        subsurface_max > 5 ~ "moderate_biomass_scm", 
        subsurface_max_surface_ratio > 3 ~ "low_biomass_scm", #was strong_subsurface, but changed to low biomass as SCM present, but at low concentrations
        TRUE ~ "weak_subsurface"
      ),
      
      # Estimate how much surface measurements underestimate
      subsurface_max_surface_perc_change = (subsurface_max - surface_chl) / subsurface_max,
      subsurface_max_near_surface_perc_change = (subsurface_max - near_surface_chl) / subsurface_max,
      
      # Depth characteristics
      subsurface_max_depth = ifelse(has_subsurface_accumulation, subsurface_max_depth, NA)
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      season = case_when(
        month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
        month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring", 
        month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
        month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
      )) %>% 
    
    select(castpk,
           date,
           station,
           season,
           has_subsurface_accumulation,
           accumulation_type, 
           subsurface_max_depth,
           subsurface_max,
           surface_chl,
           near_surface_chl,
           subsurface_max_surface_ratio,
           subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio,
           subsurface_max_surface_perc_change,
           subsurface_max_near_surface_perc_change,
           integrated_chl,
           surface_integrated,
           subsurface_integrated, 
           subsurface_integrated_fraction,
           month)
}

# Enhanced debug function for subsurface accumulations
debug_subsurface_accumulation <- function(data, target_date = NULL, target_station = NULL) {
  result <- detect_subsurface_accumulation(data)
  
  if (!is.null(target_date) && !is.null(target_station)) {
    target_result <- result %>% 
      filter(date == target_date, station == target_station)
    
    profile_data <- data %>%
      filter(date == target_date, station == target_station) %>%
      arrange(pres)
    
    if (nrow(target_result) > 0 && nrow(profile_data) > 0) {
      cat("=== SUBSURFACE ACCUMULATION ANALYSIS ===\n")
      cat("Station:", target_station, "Date:", target_date, "\n\n")
      
      cat("DETECTION RESULT:", target_result$has_subsurface_accumulation, "\n")
      cat("Type:", target_result$accumulation_type, "\n")
      cat("Depth:", target_result$subsurface_max_depth, "m\n\n")
      
      cat("BIOMASS METRICS:\n")
      cat("Surface chl (0-2m):", round(target_result$surface_chl, 2), "\n")
      cat("Near-surface chl (0-5m):", round(target_result$near_surface_chl, 2), "\n")
      cat("Subsurface maximum:", round(target_result$subsurface_max, 2), "\n")
      cat("Integrated chl:", round(target_result$integrated_chl, 2), "\n\n")
      
      cat("SURFACE MISS ANALYSIS:\n")
      cat("Surface underestimation <2m:", round(target_result$subsurface_max_surface_ratio * 100, 1), "%\n")
      cat("Surface underestimation <5m:", round(target_result$subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio * 100, 1), "%\n")
      cat("Subsurface biomass fraction:", round(target_result$subsurface_integrated_fraction * 100, 1), "%\n\n")
      
      cat("ENHANCEMENT RATIOS:\n")
      cat("vs <2m:", round(target_result$subsurface_max_surface_ratio, 2), "x\n")
      cat("vs <5m:", round(target_result$subsurface_max_near_surface_ratio, 2), "x\n\n")
      
      cat("PROFILE SUMMARY:\n")
      cat("Depth range:", min(profile_data$pres), "-", max(profile_data$pres), "m\n")
      cat("Chl range:", round(min(profile_data$f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "-", 
          round(max(profile_data$f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
      
      # Show depth distribution
      depth_bins <- cut(profile_data$pres, breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 20, 50), 
                       labels = c("0-5m", "5-10m", "10-20m", "20-50m"))
      depth_summary <- profile_data %>% 
        mutate(depth_bin = depth_bins) %>%
        group_by(depth_bin) %>%
        summarise(mean_chl = mean(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
        filter(!is.na(depth_bin))
      
      cat("Depth distribution:\n")
      for(i in 1:nrow(depth_summary)) {
        cat(" ", depth_summary$depth_bin[i], ":", round(depth_summary$mean_chl[i], 2), "\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Summary function to characterize all subsurface accumulations
summarize_subsurface_events <- function(detection_results) {
  detection_results %>%
    # filter(has_subsurface_accumulation) %>% #Probably worth turning this of as useful to see when not present?
    mutate(
      season = case_when(
        month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
        month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring", 
        month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
        month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(accumulation_type, season) %>% #Add station here if not including 
    summarise(
      count = n(),
      mean_depth = round(mean(subsurface_max_depth, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_max_chl = round(mean(subsurface_max, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_surface_miss = round(mean(subsurface_max_surface_ratio * 100, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_integrated = round(mean(integrated_chl, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_surface_integrated = round(mean(surface_integrated, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_max_chl))
}

# Create publication-quality SCM profile plot with turbidity
plot_scm_profile <- function(data, target_date, target_station, max_depth = 50) {
  
  # Filter data
  profile_data <- data %>%
    filter(date == target_date & station == target_station & pres <= max_depth)
  
  if(nrow(profile_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data found for specified date and station")
  }
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(profile_data, aes(y = pres)) +
    # Chlorophyll profile
    geom_line(aes(x = f_npq), color = "#2E8B57", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(x = f_npq), color = "#2E8B57", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    
    # Turbidity profile on secondary axis
    geom_line(aes(x = t * max(profile_data$f_npq, na.rm = TRUE) / max(profile_data$t, na.rm = TRUE)), 
              color = "#8B4513", size = 1.0, alpha = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(x = t * max(profile_data$f_npq, na.rm = TRUE) / max(profile_data$t, na.rm = TRUE)), 
               color = "#8B4513", size = 2.0, alpha = 0.8, shape = 17) +
    
    # Scales and labels
    scale_y_reverse(name = "Depth (m)", 
                    breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8),
                    expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = expression(paste("Chlorophyll fluorescence (", mu, "g L"^{-1}, ")")),
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = c(0.02, 0),
                       sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max(profile_data$t, na.rm = TRUE) / max(profile_data$f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
                                          name = "Turbidity (NTU)",
                                          breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 5))) +
    
    # Theme
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      # Axis styling
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#8B4513", angle = 90),
      axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "#8B4513"),
      axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(color = "#8B4513"),
      
      # Panel styling
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3, linetype = "dotted"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      
      # Legend and labels
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20),
      
      # Strip text for facets if needed
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    ) +
    
    # Add title and subtitle
    labs(title = paste("Vertical Profile -", target_station),
         subtitle = paste("Date:", target_date)) +
    
    # Add legend manually
    annotation_custom(
      grob = grid::textGrob(
        label = "Chlorophyll fluorescence\nTurbidity", 
        x = 0.85, y = 0.15,
        gp = grid::gpar(col = c("#2E8B57", "#8B4513"), fontsize = 9)
      )
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Alternative version with better legend, spike removal, and replicate averaging
plot_scm_profile_v2 <- function(data, target_date, target_station, max_depth = 50, 
                                remove_shallow_spikes = TRUE, spike_depth = 3) {
  
  # Filter data
  profile_data <- data %>%
    filter(date == target_date & station == target_station & pres <= max_depth)
  
  if(nrow(profile_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data found for specified date and station")
  }
  
  # Remove shallow turbidity spikes if requested
  if(remove_shallow_spikes) {
    profile_data <- profile_data %>%
      mutate(
        # Remove turbidity spikes in shallow water (1-3m)
        t_cleaned = case_when(
          pres <= spike_depth ~ {
            # Calculate median turbidity below spike zone for reference
            ref_turbidity <- median(t[pres > spike_depth & pres <= (spike_depth + 5)], na.rm = TRUE)
            # If turbidity is more than 3x the reference, replace with reference
            ifelse(t > 3 * ref_turbidity & !is.na(ref_turbidity), ref_turbidity, t)
          },
          TRUE ~ t
        )
      )
  } else {
    profile_data <- profile_data %>%
      mutate(t_cleaned = t)
  }
  
  # Average replicate casts if castpk column exists
  if("castpk" %in% colnames(profile_data)) {
    profile_summary <- profile_data %>%
      group_by(pres) %>%
      summarise(
        f_npq_mean = mean(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
        f_npq_sd = sd(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
        t_mean = mean(t_cleaned, na.rm = TRUE),
        t_sd = sd(t_cleaned, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_casts = n(),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        # Scale turbidity to match chlorophyll range for plotting
        t_scaled_mean = t_mean * max(f_npq_mean, na.rm = TRUE) / max(t_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        t_scaled_sd = t_sd * max(f_npq_mean, na.rm = TRUE) / max(t_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  } else {
    # No replicates, just process single cast
    profile_summary <- profile_data %>%
      group_by(pres) %>%
      summarise(
        f_npq_mean = mean(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
        f_npq_sd = 0,
        t_mean = mean(t_cleaned, na.rm = TRUE),
        t_sd = 0,
        n_casts = n(),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        t_scaled_mean = t_mean * max(f_npq_mean, na.rm = TRUE) / max(t_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        t_scaled_sd = 0
      )
  }
  
  # Reshape for plotting
  plot_data_mean <- profile_summary %>%
    select(pres, f_npq_mean, t_scaled_mean) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(f_npq_mean, t_scaled_mean), 
                 names_to = "variable", 
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      variable = factor(variable, 
                       levels = c("f_npq_mean", "t_scaled_mean"),
                       labels = c("Chlorophyll fluorescence", "Turbidity (scaled)"))
    )
  
  # Prepare error data for shading
  error_data <- profile_summary %>%
    select(pres, f_npq_mean, f_npq_sd, t_scaled_mean, t_scaled_sd) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(f_npq_mean, t_scaled_mean), 
                 names_to = "variable", 
                 values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      sd_value = case_when(
        variable == "f_npq_mean" ~ profile_summary$f_npq_sd[match(pres, profile_summary$pres)],
        variable == "t_scaled_mean" ~ profile_summary$t_scaled_sd[match(pres, profile_summary$pres)]
      ),
      variable = factor(variable, 
                       levels = c("f_npq_mean", "t_scaled_mean"),
                       labels = c("Chlorophyll fluorescence", "Turbidity (scaled)")),
      ymin = value - sd_value,
      ymax = value + sd_value
    )
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data_mean, aes(x = value, y = pres, color = variable)) +
    # Add shaded error bands for standard deviation
    geom_ribbon(data = error_data, 
                aes(x = value, y = pres, xmin = ymin, xmax = ymax, fill = variable),
                alpha = 0.2, color = NA, orientation = "y") +
    geom_line(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8, orientation = "y") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    
    scale_y_reverse(name = "Depth (m)", 
                    breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8),
                    expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = expression(paste("Chlorophyll fluorescence (", mu, "g L"^{-1}, ")")),
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Chlorophyll fluorescence" = "#2E8B57", 
                                 "Turbidity (scaled)" = "#8B4513"),
                       name = "Parameter") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Chlorophyll fluorescence" = "#2E8B57", 
                                "Turbidity (scaled)" = "#8B4513"),
                      guide = "none") +  # Hide fill legend since color legend covers it
    
    # Theme
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      # Axis styling
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      
      # Panel styling
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3, linetype = "dotted"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      
      # Legend styling
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", size = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      
      # Title styling
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    ) +
    
    # Add title and subtitle
    labs(title = paste("Vertical Profile -", target_station),
         subtitle = paste("Date:", target_date, 
                         ifelse(max(profile_summary$n_casts) > 1, 
                                paste("(", max(profile_summary$n_casts), "replicate casts averaged)"), 
                                "")))
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to detect high-quality SCMs with turbidity validation
detect_quality_scm <- function(data, min_depth = 5, max_depth = 50) {
  
  data %>%
    group_by(date, station, castpk) %>%
    filter(pres >= 1, pres <= max_depth, !is.na(f_npq), !is.na(t)) %>%
    arrange(pres) %>%
    filter(n() >= 8) %>%  # Sufficient depth resolution
    summarise(
      # Basic SCM metrics
      surface_chl = mean(f_npq[pres <= 3], na.rm = TRUE),
      max_chl = max(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_chl_depth = pres[which.max(f_npq)],
      subsurface_enhancement = max_chl / surface_chl,
      
      # Turbidity validation metrics
      surface_turbidity = mean(t[pres <= 3], na.rm = TRUE),
      max_turbidity = max(t, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_turbidity_depth = pres[which.max(t)],
      
      # Co-variation between chlorophyll and turbidity
      chl_turb_correlation = cor(f_npq, t, use = "complete.obs"),
      
      # Depth alignment between maxima
      depth_alignment = abs(max_chl_depth - max_turbidity_depth),
      
      # Profile shape similarity
      chl_profile_range = max(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE) - min(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
      turb_profile_range = max(t, na.rm = TRUE) - min(t, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Subsurface accumulation strength
      subsurface_chl_mean = mean(f_npq[pres > min_depth], na.rm = TRUE),
      surface_chl_mean = mean(f_npq[pres <= min_depth], na.rm = TRUE),
      subsurface_turb_mean = mean(t[pres > min_depth], na.rm = TRUE),
      surface_turb_mean = mean(t[pres <= min_depth], na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Quality flags
      has_clear_scm = max_chl_depth > min_depth & subsurface_enhancement > 1.5,
      has_turbidity_peak = max_turbidity_depth > min_depth,
      
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Key quality criteria for SCM with turbidity validation
      high_quality_scm = case_when(
        # Strong correlation between chl and turbidity
        chl_turb_correlation > 0.6 &
        # Maxima are co-located (within 3m)
        depth_alignment <= 3 &
        # Clear subsurface enhancement
        subsurface_enhancement > 1.5 &
        # Maximum occurs in subsurface
        max_chl_depth > min_depth &
        # Sufficient signal strength
        max_chl > 2.0 ~ TRUE,
        
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      
      # Classify SCM quality
      scm_quality = case_when(
        !has_clear_scm ~ "no_scm",
        high_quality_scm ~ "high_quality",
        chl_turb_correlation > 0.4 & depth_alignment <= 5 ~ "moderate_quality",
        TRUE ~ "poor_quality"
      )
    )
}

# Function to find the best SCM examples
find_best_scm_examples <- function(data, n_examples = 10) {
  
  scm_results <- detect_quality_scm(data)
  
  # Rank by multiple quality criteria
  best_examples <- scm_results %>%
    filter(high_quality_scm == TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # Composite quality score
      quality_score = 
        (chl_turb_correlation * 0.4) +  # Correlation weight
        (pmin(subsurface_enhancement, 5) / 5 * 0.3) +  # Enhancement (capped at 5x)
        (pmax(0, 5 - depth_alignment) / 5 * 0.2) +  # Depth alignment (closer = better)
        (pmin(max_chl, 20) / 20 * 0.1)  # Signal strength (capped at 20)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(quality_score)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_examples)
  
  return(best_examples)
}

# Function to create summary plots of SCM quality
plot_scm_quality_summary <- function(scm_results) {
  
  # Correlation vs Enhancement plot
  p1 <- scm_results %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = chl_turb_correlation, y = subsurface_enhancement, 
               color = scm_quality)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("high_quality" = "#2E8B57",
                                 "moderate_quality" = "#FFB347", 
                                 "poor_quality" = "#CD5C5C",
                                 "no_scm" = "#708090")) +
    labs(x = "Chlorophyll-Turbidity Correlation",
         y = "Subsurface Enhancement Ratio",
         title = "SCM Quality Assessment",
         color = "Quality") +
    theme_classic()
  
  # Depth alignment plot
  p2 <- scm_results %>%
    filter(has_clear_scm) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = depth_alignment, fill = scm_quality)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("high_quality" = "#2E8B57",
                                "moderate_quality" = "#FFB347", 
                                "poor_quality" = "#CD5C5C")) +
    labs(x = "Depth Alignment (m) between Chl and Turbidity Maxima",
         y = "Count",
         title = "Depth Alignment Distribution") +
    theme_classic()
  
  # Combine plots
  library(patchwork)
  combined_plot <- p1 / p2
  
  return(combined_plot)
}

# Function to detect high-quality SCMs with turbidity validation
detect_quality_scm <- function(data, min_depth = 5, max_depth = 50) {
  
  data %>%
    group_by(date, station, castpk) %>%
    filter(pres >= 1, pres <= max_depth, !is.na(f_npq), !is.na(t)) %>%
    arrange(pres) %>%
    filter(n() >= 8) %>%  # Sufficient depth resolution
    summarise(
      # Basic SCM metrics
      surface_chl = mean(f_npq[pres <= 3], na.rm = TRUE),
      max_chl = max(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_chl_depth = pres[which.max(f_npq)],
      subsurface_enhancement = max_chl / surface_chl,
      
      # Turbidity validation metrics
      surface_turbidity = mean(t[pres <= 3], na.rm = TRUE),
      max_turbidity = max(t, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_turbidity_depth = pres[which.max(t)],
      
      # Co-variation between chlorophyll and turbidity
      chl_turb_correlation = cor(f_npq, t, use = "complete.obs"),
      
      # Depth alignment between maxima
      depth_alignment = abs(max_chl_depth - max_turbidity_depth),
      
      # Profile shape similarity
      chl_profile_range = max(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE) - min(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
      turb_profile_range = max(t, na.rm = TRUE) - min(t, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Subsurface accumulation strength
      subsurface_chl_mean = mean(f_npq[pres > min_depth], na.rm = TRUE),
      surface_chl_mean = mean(f_npq[pres <= min_depth], na.rm = TRUE),
      subsurface_turb_mean = mean(t[pres > min_depth], na.rm = TRUE),
      surface_turb_mean = mean(t[pres <= min_depth], na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Quality flags
      has_clear_scm = max_chl_depth > min_depth & subsurface_enhancement > 1.5,
      has_turbidity_peak = max_turbidity_depth > min_depth,
      
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # Key quality criteria for SCM with turbidity validation
      high_quality_scm = case_when(
        # Strong correlation between chl and turbidity
        chl_turb_correlation > 0.6 &
        # Maxima are co-located (within 3m)
        depth_alignment <= 3 &
        # Clear subsurface enhancement
        subsurface_enhancement > 1.5 &
        # Maximum occurs in subsurface
        max_chl_depth > min_depth &
        # Sufficient signal strength
        max_chl > 2.0 ~ TRUE,
        
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      
      # Classify SCM quality
      scm_quality = case_when(
        !has_clear_scm ~ "no_scm",
        high_quality_scm ~ "high_quality",
        chl_turb_correlation > 0.4 & depth_alignment <= 5 ~ "moderate_quality",
        TRUE ~ "poor_quality"
      )
    )
}

# Function to find the best SCM examples
find_best_scm_examples <- function(data, n_examples = 10) {
  
  scm_results <- detect_quality_scm(data)
  
  # Rank by multiple quality criteria
  best_examples <- scm_results %>%
    filter(high_quality_scm == TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # Composite quality score
      quality_score = 
        (chl_turb_correlation * 0.4) +  # Correlation weight
        (pmin(subsurface_enhancement, 5) / 5 * 0.3) +  # Enhancement (capped at 5x)
        (pmax(0, 5 - depth_alignment) / 5 * 0.2) +  # Depth alignment (closer = better)
        (pmin(max_chl, 20) / 20 * 0.1)  # Signal strength (capped at 20)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(quality_score)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_examples)
  
  return(best_examples)
}

# Function to create summary plots of SCM quality
plot_scm_quality_summary <- function(scm_results) {
  
  # Correlation vs Enhancement plot
  p1 <- scm_results %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = chl_turb_correlation, y = subsurface_enhancement, 
               color = scm_quality)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("high_quality" = "#2E8B57",
                                 "moderate_quality" = "#FFB347", 
                                 "poor_quality" = "#CD5C5C",
                                 "no_scm" = "#708090")) +
    labs(x = "Chlorophyll-Turbidity Correlation",
         y = "Subsurface Enhancement Ratio",
         title = "SCM Quality Assessment",
         color = "Quality") +
    theme_classic()
  
  # Depth alignment plot
  p2 <- scm_results %>%
    filter(has_clear_scm) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = depth_alignment, fill = scm_quality)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("high_quality" = "#2E8B57",
                                "moderate_quality" = "#FFB347", 
                                "poor_quality" = "#CD5C5C")) +
    labs(x = "Depth Alignment (m) between Chl and Turbidity Maxima",
         y = "Count",
         title = "Depth Alignment Distribution") +
    theme_classic()
  
  # Combine plots
  library(patchwork)
  combined_plot <- p1 / p2
  
  return(combined_plot)
}
```

```{r}
# Assuming your data is in a dataframe called 'ctd_data'
# If loading from file, uncomment and modify:
# ctd_data <- read.csv("your_file.csv")

# Data preparation
ctd_processed <- ctd_data %>%
  # Convert date to Date format if it's not already
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  # Filter to top 30m (assuming pressure ~ depth)
  filter(pres <= 30) %>%
  # Remove NA values
  drop_na(date, pres, f_npq) %>%
  # If multiple casts per day, you can either:
  # Option 1: Average them
  group_by(date, pres) %>%
  summarise(f_npq = mean(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # Option 2: If you want to keep separate casts, comment out the above and use:
  # group_by(date, castpk, pres) %>%
  # summarise(f_npq = mean(f_npq, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # Convert date to numeric for interpolation
  mutate(date_numeric = as.numeric(date))

# Create interpolation grid
date_range <- range(ctd_processed$date_numeric)
pres_range <- c(0, 30)  # Surface to 30m

# Create regular grid for interpolation
date_grid <- seq(date_range[1], date_range[2], length.out = 100)
pres_grid <- seq(pres_range[1], pres_range[2], length.out = 50)

# Perform interpolation using akima
interp_result <- with(ctd_processed, 
                     interp(x = date_numeric, y = pres, z = f_npq,
                           xo = date_grid, yo = pres_grid,
                           linear = TRUE, extrap = FALSE))

# Convert interpolated data to long format for ggplot
interp_df <- expand.grid(date_numeric = interp_result$x,
                        pres = interp_result$y) %>%
  mutate(f_npq = as.vector(interp_result$z),
         date = as.Date(date_numeric, origin = "1970-01-01"))

fluor_palette_v3 <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#08306b",  # Deep navy blue
  "#1f4e7a",  # Dark blue
  "#2e6b89",  # Medium blue
  "#4d8fc7",  # Bright blue
  "#2fb3d4",  # Vivid cyan-blue (bloom threshold)
  "#00a693",  # Bright teal
  "#4daf4a",  # Vibrant green
  "#8cc152",  # Lime green
  "#ffd23f",  # Bright yellow
  "#ff8c42",  # Vivid orange
  "#e74c3c"   # Bold red-orange
))

colors_v3 <- fluor_palette_v3(50)

# Function to create breaks that emphasize bloom threshold
create_fluor_breaks <- function(max_val = 50, bloom_threshold = 5) {
  # More breaks in the 0-10 range to capture bloom dynamics
  c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, bloom_threshold, 7, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, max_val)
}



# Create the section plot
p <- ggplot(interp_df, aes(x = date, y = pres, fill = f_npq)) +
  geom_raster() +
  # geom_tile() +
  # Use viridis color scale (good for fluorescence/chlorophyll data)
  # scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Fluorescence",
  #                      na.value = "white",
  #                      trans = "log10",  # Log transform for wide range
  #                      labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
  # Alternative color scales you might prefer:
  # scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "green", high = "red", 
  #                      midpoint = median(interp_df$f_npq, na.rm = TRUE),
  #                      trans = "log10") +
  # or
  # 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = colors_v3,
                       values = scales::rescale(c(0, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50))) +

  # Flip y-axis so surface is at top
  scale_y_reverse(name = "Pressure (dbar)", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_date(name = "Date", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  
  # Add original data points
  geom_point(data = ctd_processed,
             aes(x = as.Date(date_numeric, origin = "1970-01-01"),
                 y = pres, fill = f_npq),
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
  
  # Theming
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  
  labs(title = "CTD Fluorescence Section Plot",
       subtitle = "Interpolated fluorescence (f_npq) by date and depth")

# Display the plot
print(p)
```
